question.title: Insertion sort
question.description: Sort a list of integers. Standard sorting templates create a measurable natural similarity risk.

cases.code_b:
# formatting-only synthetic variant

def arrange(numbers):
    data = list(numbers)
    for i in range(1, len(data)):
        key = data[i]
        j = i - 1
        while j >= 0 and data[j] > key:
            data[j + 1] = data[j]
            j -= 1
        data[j + 1] = key
    return data
